_comment: A split doubleheader: ESPN returns one event per game, both with the
same (date, home_team, away_team) and different start times. The start
times are the real pair in data/games/games.csv -- game_pk 823539 (game
2026-08-29 Red Sox at Yankees -- re-dated onto the suite's DAY. The
home/away sides here are SWAPPED relative to those rows, which store
home New York Yankees / away Boston Red Sox: the fixture matches the
suite's own _game() rows in tests/test_finals_backfill.py, which store
home Boston Red Sox / away New York Yankees. Only the two start times
and the scores are taken from the real pair.
